question: At the 2024 Paris Olympics, Manu Bhaker made history by becoming the first Indian woman to win an Olympic shooting medal and the first Indian to win ____ medals in shooting events.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Manu Bhaker is an accomplished Indian sport shooter, known for her impressive performances in international events.
 
• At the 2024 Paris Olympics, she made history by becoming the first Indian woman to win an Olympic shooting medal.
 
• She also became the first Indian to win a total of 4 medals in shooting events at a single edition of the Olympics.
 
• Her achievement has set a new benchmark for Indian shooting sports and brought significant recognition to the country.
 
• Bhaker's success is attributed to her dedication, rigorous training, and support from national sports bodies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Olympic Shooting Events**

 
 
• Shooting sports at the Olympics include events for rifles, pistols, and shotguns.
 
• Disciplines include 10m Air Rifle, 10m Air Pistol, 25m Pistol, 50m Rifle Three Positions, and Skeet, among others.
 
• Competitors aim for precision and accuracy in hitting targets to score points.
 
 
 
• **Training and Preparation**
 
 
• Top-level shooters undergo rigorous training, including mental conditioning, physical fitness, and technical drills.
 
• Consistency and focus are crucial for success in competitive shooting.
 
 
 
• **India’s Performance in Shooting**
 
 
• India has a growing reputation in shooting sports, with several athletes winning medals in international competitions.
 
• The country invests in training facilities and support systems to nurture talent in this field.
 
 
 
• **Manu Bhaker’s Career Highlights**
 
 
• Bhaker has won multiple medals in Youth Olympics, ISSF World Cup, and Commonwealth Games.
 
• Her determination and success have inspired many young athletes in India.
